title: Observability stack — OpenTelemetry + Langfuse instrumentation (TRACING ONLY, no agent logic changes)
goal: Instrument every picker call, runner dispatch, memory operation, validator decision, and tool execution with OpenTelemetry traces sent to Langfuse. Per Codex refinement: TRACING ONLY — zero changes to agent logic, dispatch, or runner behavior in this task. Establishes the cockpit's speedometer before subsequent tasks build the engine.
scope: Three additive code changes (no behavioral changes): (1) `pip install opentelemetry-api opentelemetry-sdk opentelemetry-instrumentation-fastapi opentelemetry-instrumentation-sqlalchemy langfuse` added to api/requirements.txt + workers/requirements.txt. (2) New `api/app/observability/tracing.py` module that initializes the OTEL TracerProvider with Langfuse OTLP exporter; reads endpoint+key from env vars LANGFUSE_HOST + LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY + LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY. (3) Decorator-based instrumentation at the boundaries: `@traced('picker.advance')` on `advance_assessment_loop`, `@traced('picker.claude_call')` on `_claude_select_next_action`, `@traced('runner.dispatch')` on `dispatch_runner`, `@traced('memory.read'/'memory.write')` on memory_backend public functions. Each trace carries run_id + task_id + engagement_id as span attributes. Cost/latency tokens automatically captured from Anthropic SDK response metadata.
generation_reason: Per Codex review 2026-05-20: 'Observability eerst — zonder Langfuse/OTEL blijven we raden waarom de agent iets doet.' Sprint mythos-foundation produced 24 claude_picks across 5 targets but operators could not see WHY any specific decision was made. This task is the cockpit instrumentation before subsequent capability tasks; without it we cannot debug the exploitation engine we're about to build. Per ANTI_DRIFT.md Rule 1: this task is NOT a capability task (it changes no behavior); its delta-metric is observational (% of agent decisions with traceable rationale).

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md AND ANTI_DRIFT.md + SESSION_PROMPT.md have been loaded as session kickoff context.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: TRACING ONLY — per Codex refinement. NO changes to agent logic, dispatch, runner behavior, prompts, or decision-making code paths. The diff is restricted to: new tracing module, decorator additions at function boundaries, requirements.txt entries. Any agent-logic edit found in this task's commits invalidates the DONE claim.
constraints.no_secrets_in_traces: Langfuse traces may contain finding titles, target URLs (scope-allowlisted only), and tool names. Never raw response bodies, credential values, or session tokens. Add explicit redaction in span attribute setters.
constraints.graceful_degradation: When LANGFUSE_* env vars unset OR Langfuse unreachable: tracing falls back to local stdout/log destination silently. NO impact on agent runtime.

success_criteria: Metric: ≥90% of picker.advance calls have an associated OTEL trace_id visible in Langfuse (measured over a 20-advance test run).
Metric: ≥95% of runner.dispatch invocations have parent-trace linkage to their triggering picker.advance.
Metric: untraced agent decisions count = 0 (per Codex: zero untraced decisions is the target).
Each trace carries span attributes: run_id, task_id, engagement_id, tool_name (where applicable), confidence_score (where present in decision metadata).
Cost metrics: input_tokens / output_tokens / cache_read_tokens captured per Anthropic API call as span events.
Failure mode: Langfuse down → app continues normally (graceful_degradation tested).
Greppable assertion: NO behavioral code edits outside the 6 listed key_files (verified via `git diff --stat`).
Unit tests: trace decorator unit-tested with in-memory exporter; span structure asserted.
Live: 1 manual smoke-test advance against any target shows full trace tree in local Langfuse instance OR exported OTLP collector.
must_not_touch: _claude_select_next_action body (only decorator added at function signature)
All 30+ workers/runners/*/runner.py bodies (only optional decorator on execute_* functions)

required_checks: git diff --stat api/app/services/assessment_loop.py workers/orchestration/tasks.py api/app/services/memory_backend.py | awk '{print $3+$5}' | paste -sd+ | bc
acceptance_criteria: ≥90% picker.advance calls in 20-advance smoke run have OTEL trace_id (verifiable via Langfuse UI OR OTLP collector log).
Cost metrics captured per Anthropic API call.
Graceful degradation: app runs identically when Langfuse env vars unset.
ZERO behavioral edits to picker/dispatcher/runner logic (git diff stat shows additive-only changes outside the new tracing module).
